articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Meta's AI support bot got social-engineered into handing over Instagram accounts like a helpful intern with root access. The Obama White House and Space Force accounts got pro-Iranian makeovers because apparently even AI falls for basic phishing.

articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada
articles.summary: Congress is rightfully losing its mind after CISA—the agency that's supposed to secure America's infrastructure—let a contractor dump AWS GovCloud keys on GitHub like a freshman's homework. The irony is so thick you could cut it with a CVE.

articles.title: Internet Age-Gates Are a Growing Global Threat
articles.summary: A CISA contractor casually posted AWS GovCloud credentials and internal system access on public GitHub because apparently operational security is just a suggestion. This is like finding the keys to Fort Knox taped to a lamppost.

articles.title: LGBT Q&A Season 1 Recap: Staying Safer Online
articles.summary: Governments worldwide are pushing age verification that would destroy online anonymity faster than you can say 'surveillance state.' EFF explains why these 'think of the children' laws are digital dystopia in sheep's clothing.

articles.title: EFF Testifies to Congress on Protecting Americans’ Rights from Government AI
articles.summary: Trump's unqualified DNI appointment perfectly illustrates why warrantless mass surveillance under Section 702 needs to die. When political hacks get the keys to the NSA's toy box, everyone's privacy goes out the window.

articles.title: World Food Programme breach exposes data of 600k vulnerable Gazan families
articles.summary: Another Cisco SD-WAN zero-day is being actively exploited with no patch in sight. Sys admins everywhere are updating their CVs and questioning their life choices.

articles.title: Miasma Worm Hits 73 Microsoft GitHub Repositories in Major Supply Chain Attack
articles.summary: An AI agent just pwned FFmpeg with 21 zero-days while Google patched a record 429 Chrome bugs. The robots are getting scary good at finding our mistakes, and honestly, we're here for it.

articles.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager CVE-2026-20245 Flaw Actively Exploited – No Patch Available
articles.summary: The Miasma worm hit 73 Microsoft GitHub repos in a supply chain attack that spread like digital wildfire. Even Microsoft isn't immune to getting owned by self-replicating malware.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Massive ZCash Exploit Found by Claude, Extent Unknown
articles.summary: Cisco's SD-WAN Manager has another actively exploited zero-day with no patch available. At this point, Cisco should just rename their products to 'CVE Generator Pro.'

articles.title: No data breach: IIT Roorkee rubbishes claims of privacy violation affecting JEE Advanced 2026 students
articles.summary: Five Eyes warns that Chinese spies are sliding into government employees' DMs with fake job offers. LinkedIn recruiters were already suspicious, but now they might actually be foreign intelligence.
